text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As {0} and his group climbed the Tower of Luna, they were attacked by monsters for the umpteenth time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルナの塔を登る{0}たち一行は
何度目かの魔物たちの襲撃を受けていた。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: TEYAAAAAAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
てやあああ！　
ッス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Wait, even this isn't enough to take you down, pal?
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
これじゃあ倒れないッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, Matsuri-chan! Try again...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だよ
マツリちゃん！
もう一度……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Another one's coming at me now! Take this, you...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわっ！　
また出たッス！
この、
このっ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Calm down, Matsuri-chan! You need to beat them one by one!
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ち着いて
マツリちゃん！
一体ずつ倒していこう！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: R-Roger that, pal! TEYAAAAAHHH! Take this! And that!
text_block_list.orig_text:
りょ、
了解ッス！
てーい！　
この！　
この！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Nice one, Matsuri-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃん、
ナイス！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I managed to defeat them, but... the monsters here are getting stronger and stronger...
text_block_list.orig_text:
倒せたッスけど……
魔物が
どんどん強くなってるッス……

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: If a lot of monsters like those were to show up, things might get dangerous... Should we just keep going on our own? Are you okay, {0}?
text_block_list.orig_text:
今みたいな魔物が
たくさん出てきたら
危ないかもしれないッス……
こ、
このまま
自分たちだけで進むべきッスかね？
{0}さんは
大丈夫ッスか？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: I think the reason you're worried is because you can see your surroundings so clearly. Matsuri-chan, the two of us will be just fine! Let's keep going!
text_block_list.orig_text:
心配になってるのは
周りがよく見えているからこそだと思うな。
マツリちゃんとあたしたちなら大丈夫だよ！
このまま進んでいこう！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: A-All right, pal. C-Certainly, it seems like I've been weak-willed lately... But if Hiyori-san, who has been on many adventures, says so, then it'll be fine!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
分かったッス。
確かに
ちょっと弱気になっていたかも……
いろんな冒険をしているヒヨリさんが
言うなら
大丈夫ッスね！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, as expected...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうッスよね……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Matsuri-chan, you're currently just too anxious and unable to perform at your full potential, I know you're normally able to move a lot more than that! I think if you just relax a little, you'll be fine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃんは
不安になって実力が出せていないだけで
本当はもっと動けるはずだよ。
リラックスさえすれば
あたしは大丈夫だと思うけどなあ。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Relax, you say...? I-I got it... I'll give it a try...! Fuuu... Aaah...
text_block_list.orig_text:
リラックス……
ッスか？
わ、
分かったッス……
やってみるッス……！
すー……
はー……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: THERE'S ANOTHER ONE RIGHT AWAY! And it looks even stronger than before! A-Are we sure we can beat this foe by ourselves...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
また出たッスー！
さっきよりも
強そうな魔物ッス！
じ、
自分
勝てるッスか……？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: It's no time to get weak-willed! Matsuri-chan, you... you're already a great hero!
text_block_list.orig_text:
弱気になっちゃダメだよ！
マツリちゃんは
もう立派なヒーローなんだから！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Hah! Th-That's right...! I can't allow myself to lose here...! But...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハッ！　
そ、
そうッス……！
自分は
こんなところで負けるわけにはいかないッス……！
でも……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: There's one here too?! I'll take care of this one! Hang in there, Matsuri-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こっちからも！？　
ここはあたしが引き受けるよ！
マツリちゃん、
心配しないで！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Wahhh! Before we knew it, we got surrounded! So, does that mean... I have to defeat this monster all on my own?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわわっ！　
いつのまにか
囲まれてるッス！
って、
ことは……
自分一人でこの魔物を倒すしかないってことッスか！？

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Calm down and strike steady! Matsuri-chan, you can definitely defeat a monster of that size!
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ち着いて
よく狙って！
あれくらいの魔物、
マツリちゃんなら絶対勝てるよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Hiyori-san! I-I'm doing fine here, so I'd love if you paid attention to your own fight!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリさん！
こ、
こっちは大丈夫ッスから
前見て戦ってほしいッス！

text_block_list.name: ヒヨリ
text_block_list.text:
フレー！　
マツリちゃん！
頑張れ頑張れマツリちゃん！
text_block_list.orig_text:
フレー！　
マツリちゃん！
頑張れ頑張れマツリちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Hiyori-san... And {0}-san too...! Ugh, I don't have time to be weak...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリさん……
{0}さんも……！
ううっ、
弱気になっちゃダメッス…！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: If I were alone, I might've gotten easily discouraged... But, for the sake of my friends! I want to live up to their expectations...!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分一人だとくじけちゃうかもしれないッスけど……
でも、
仲間のために！
二人の期待に応えたいッス……！！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: When I think of the two of you... N-New strength wells up inside of me! I'll muster up all of my COURAGE!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二人のことを考えたら……
ち、
力が沸き上がってきたッス！
勇気を、
ふり絞るッスよー！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Matsuri-chan! GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃん！　
いっけー！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: This is my... ultimate strike of justice! TEIYAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが……
正義の一撃ッス！！
てーやー！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: I-I did it, pal! I was able to defeat it on my own!
text_block_list.orig_text:
や、
やったッス！
自分一人でも倒せたッス！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Phew... This one's down, too! We did it, Matsuri-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふう……
こっちもやっつけたよ！
やったね、
マツリちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: It's all thanks to you, Hiyori-san! The moment I received support from both you and {0}, I was suddenly overflowing with energy and courage!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリさんのおかげッスよ！
ヒヨリさんと
{0}さんの応援を受けたら、
元気と勇気があふれてきたッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm happy to hear you say that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えへへ、
そう言ってもらえるとうれしいな。

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Cheering up everyone with her unique support! So this is what Hiyori-san's dream is all about. I think I'm starting to get it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
応援でみんなを元気づける！
これが
ヒヨリさんがやりたいことなんッスね。
分かってきた気がするッス！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Matsuri-chan, back there, you were so cool and heroic!
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃんもヒーローらしくて
かっこよかったよ！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Y-You think so? But that image only existed thanks to Hiyori-san's support!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そうッスかね？
でも
それもこれも
ヒヨリさんから
元気をもらったおかげッス！！

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Giving everyone energy and courage, that's truly an amazing feat... It's just like you're...
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなに
元気と勇気を与えるのって
すごいッス……
それって
まるで……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Matsuri-chan? What's wrong?
text_block_list.orig_text:
マツリちゃん？　
どうかした？

text_block_list.name: Matsuri
text_block_list.text: Heh, I was just thinking about a little something! Alright, let's keep going like this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと考え事ッス！
よーし、
この調子でどんどん進むッスよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Yeeeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: おー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: With Hiyori and {0}'s encouragement, Matsuri gained confidence, and with them all leading the way the tower climbing proceeded steadily.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリと{0}の応援で自信をつけた
マツリを先頭に、一同は塔を登るのであった。
